directAnswer.en: For concrete pump main cylinder seal 461K, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Polyphase system. Polyphase system only lends its headings. The 461K main-cylinder seal is one set on the Xingtai main-cylinder seal page. The full mark list is φ63, φ80, 80×125, 90×140, 90–160, 95×140, 100×150 and 461K. This note is only 461K.
directAnswer.zh: 写concrete pump main cylinder seal 461K时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《Polyphase system》借数字。《Polyphase system》只出借标题。 461K 主油缸密封是邢台主油缸密封页上的一套。全部标记是 φ63、φ80、80×125、90×140、90–160、95×140、100×150 和 461K。本文只写 461K。

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “Number of phases” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. 461K is a kit code, not an outer diameter on the main-cylinder seal kit. Unit: set. Material is not printed. Service life is not printed. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Some pump pages name a hydraulic pump such as a Kawasaki unit. That cell is not this seal kit, and it is not a spare-part page for a hydraulic pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Copy the mark as 461K. Do not normalise 90–160 into 90×160, and do not turn 461K into a diameter. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: “来源章节：Number of phases”这几个字不是第二张数据表。若目录印过数据，下面引用的才是那一句。 461K 是主油缸密封套件上的套件代号，不是外径。单位：套。材料没有印。寿命没有印。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 有的泵页写了川崎等液压泵。那一格不是这套密封，也不是液压泵的配件页。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 标记按 461K 原文抄。不要把 90–160 规范成 90×160，也不要把 461K 改成直径。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Motors”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. The 461K main-cylinder seal is one set on the Xingtai main-cylinder seal page. The full mark list is φ63, φ80, 80×125, 90×140, 90–160, 95×140, 100×150 and 461K. This note is only 461K. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“电动机”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 461K 主油缸密封是邢台主油缸密封页上的一套。全部标记是 φ63、φ80、80×125、90×140、90–160、95×140、100×150 和 461K。本文只写 461K。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: “Higher phase order” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 主油缸密封 page plus this size and the quantity. The heading stops there.
